engine.notes: The Improv Shop is the scene's center of gravity. ComedySportz St. Louis (cszstlouis.com) is live and advertises weekly matches in Webster Groves and Maryland Heights, but its newest dated class is February 2025 and its ticketing page refused the fetch, so it needs a human check before listing. The Improv Trick, once a St. Louis school, now teaches in Los Angeles.

entries.name: The Improv Shop
entries.summary: St. Louis's improv theater and training center in The Grove, with shows four nights a week including House Team Night and Cagematch, and a curriculum from Level 0 through Level 4 plus Teams levels and sketch.
entries.schedule: Shows Mon, Thu, Fri and Sat; next class session November 2026 to January 2027
entries.reasons: The full training-theater package of levelled classes, a path onto teams, house-team nights and a dated four-night calendar in a permanent home; only the founding year is missing from the site.

entries.name: Bob Baker's Improv Comedy Class
entries.summary: A monthly drop-in improv class run by performer Bob Baker at the Center for Spiritual Living, open to all for $15 at the door, with occasional improv cabaret shows.
entries.schedule: Second Monday of every month, 7-9 pm, $15 at the door
signals: Center for Spiritual Living, 12875 Fee Fee Rd
entries.reasons: A single monthly drop-in with no levels, no venue of its own and no show calendar; listed because it is a real, current and cheap way into improv in the county.
